physical_scope: Two cell-owned finite neutral assembly pools regulating channels in the qualified spatial_extracellular@2 cluster; one shared local bath and three extracellular regions
hypothesis: The presence of a cycle in the retained assembly controls its owner's channel availability; no chemical feedback or protein energetics
checks: Separate material balances and independent cell random streams
Union of assembly event clocks, including simultaneous events on an ionic grid boundary
Independent scalar pool histories plus independently implemented spatial DOP853 and Radau references
Timestep refinement, exact same-backend disk restart, window and world partition invariance at widths 1, 2 and 3, including nonzero world IDs; preserve all partition endpoints
Ring/open same-material controls with connected, junction-off, fully isolated receiver and disabled assembly coupling
One-cell/no-face reduction to the existing assembly_regulated_cell@1 model
CPU/L4 agreement, complete public CLI checkpoints and observations
Real two-worker L4 ensemble queue; per-cell outcomes without double-counting independent worlds
Existing finite-pool and one-cell coupled regression suites

tolerances.ionic_conservation_and_domain: unchanged spatial model checks at every RK4 trial and endpoint; accounting at saved observations and endpoints

scope_exclusions: Native BETSE spatial parity or full BETSE equivalence
Cross-region junctions, shared protein pools, protein energy or feedback to assembly rates
Minimum GPU utilization, GH200 deployment or multi-GPU scaling
